decision.explanation: The ceramic serving bowl in order O0060 was delivered broken (damaged) on 2026-09-13 and reported within the 10-day return window. As the item price is ₹399 (under ₹500) but the policy requires immediate refund only for wrong items under ₹500, and for damaged items scheduled return is required, we will schedule a return pickup. The user has not uploaded photo evidence (required only if item price > ₹2000). The refund will be processed automatically after pickup completion.
